paragraphs: Linewize sells filtering and student safety software to schools and districts. These pages describe a suite of child cyber safety and wellbeing solutions. Those solutions are grouped under three pillars: prevention and enablement, early detection and intervention, and education and engagement.

Linewize Filter is content-aware, hybrid filtering that gives IT granular control and flexible rule configuration. Linewize Classroom Manager gives teachers control in the modern digital classroom. EdTech Manager reports on a district's app usage, student screen time, compliance and adoption. Linewize Monitor alerts designated staff to students whose digital behaviors indicate they may be at risk, using human moderated threat detection.

Linewize Pulse offers school-wide wellbeing insights and a channel for students to speak up if they need support. Qustodio enables parents to see and supervise their child's online activity on school-issued devices. School districts are named on these pages as the customers choosing Linewize. Linewize North America is part of Qoria, described as a family of child digital safety technology providers.
